messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer hitting schema validation on tool/invoke calls. Getting a 400 with `additionalProperties` for keys they swear they didn't send. Payload + error below, can someone triage?

maria_support: Error from gateway: `ValidationError: additionalProperties \"session\" not allowed; required
 properties missing: billing_profile.id`

maria_support: Payload they sent:
```json
{
  "tool": "billing.createInvoice",
  "args": {
    "amount": "1500",
    "currency": "USD",
    "session": {
      "session_id": "abc123"
    },
    "billingProfile": {
      "name": "Acme Co"
    }
  },
  "metadata": null
}
```

devin_eng: Hmm — two things jump out: 1) `amount` is a string (schema expects integer/cents) so coercion might fail; 2) `billing_profile` is required and must include `id` (they sent `billingProfile` with different casing and missing id). Gateway uses strict JSON Schema (additionalProperties=false) for tool args, so `session` will be rejected.

liam_oncall: Also, note our gateway normalizes keys but only after schema checks for some endpoints. So camelCase vs snake_case mismatch could cause required-field detection to fail earlier. Can you repro with a cURL showing exact headers?

maria_support: Repro cURL from customer (redacted keys):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool/invoke \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"billing.createInvoice","args":{"amount":"1500","currency":"USD","session":{"session_id":"abc123"},"billingProfile":{"name":"Acme Co"}}}'
```

devin_eng: OK reproducible. Root cause: our JSON Schema for billing.createInvoice sets additionalProperties: false and requires `billing_profile.id` as string|uuid and `amount` as integer. Two separate failures cascade into an `additionalProperties` surface because the payload's camelCase keys don't map and leave an unexpected `billingProfile` object.

devin_eng: Short-term fix: accept camelCase aliases and coerce numeric strings for amount (non-breaking shim) — I'll push a small compatibility patch to the gateway. Also will add clearer validation error text so customers see both "missing required field billing_profile.id" and "type mismatch for amount" instead of only additionalProperties.

liam_oncall: Can we also add a logging hook to capture the raw incoming payload before normalization so support can show exact diff to customers?

devin_eng: Yep, will add a one-line access log (payload diff) behind a feature flag scoped to support tickets.

maria_support: Thanks — customer is blocked in prod, high priority. Can we ETA the shim?

devin_eng: I'll open a PR now, aim for a hotfix to rollout to gateway in ~45m. If latency on deploy blocks, we'll route their traffic to a canary region with the shim.

infra-bot: deploy started: gateway-compat-shim hotfix #3421 (canary) — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/3421

maria_support: Appreciate it. Will update the customer and attach repro steps + recommended payload example using snake_case + integer amount.

liam_oncall: Follow-up: create an issue to review schema leniency vs strictness for all user-facing tools (link it to support runbook). I'll file after hotfix verification. :+1:
